sys.title: System status
sys.text.offline: Can’t reach gbs-anywhere. Is it running, and is this phone on the same network?
sys.text.checking: The grinder is taking the result: step 3 of 3.
sys.text.knob: Ground. Press the grinder’s rotary knob to start the shot: step 1 of 3.
sys.text.needsId: Almost done: in the setup, enter the Pairing ID the grinder shows.
sys.text.pairing: Pairing in progress: leave the grinder alone until it shows its normal screen again.

sys.text.quiet.one: No answer to the pairing check: gbs-anywhere sends the grinder nothing for {n} minute, then checks again. Leave the grinder alone meanwhile.
sys.text.quiet.other: No answer to the pairing check: gbs-anywhere sends the grinder nothing for {n} minutes, then checks again. Leave the grinder alone meanwhile.

sys.text.accept: A Pairing Code is waiting: go on in the setup, and accept it on the grinder once it matches.
sys.text.setup: The grinder answers, but isn’t paired with gbs-anywhere yet. The setup takes you through it step by step.
sys.text.error: The last shot did not reach the grinder.
sys.text.problem: The grinder answers, but turned down the last request. gbs-anywhere keeps trying.
sys.text.integError: {title} is not working right now. You can still grind and enter the shot by hand.
sys.text.done: The last shot reached the grinder {ago}. Ready for the next one.
sys.text.doneNoTime: The last shot reached the grinder. Ready for the next one.
sys.text.aborted: Shot aborted. Grind again to start the next one.
sys.missing.e64: The grinder is not polling. Is it switched on and paired with gbs-anywhere (it appears as ‘Xenia’ on the grinder)?
sys.missing.wifi: The grinder does not answer. Is it switched on? gbs-anywhere reconnects by itself as soon as it can reach it.
sys.missing.linkError: The grinder answers, but the connection is not working right now. gbs-anywhere keeps trying.
setup.title: Set up grinder
setup.s1.title: Connect the grinder
setup.s1.text: Add the grinder to the same network as gbs-anywhere and enter its IP address. You find it on the grinder under Connectivity or in your router’s device list.
setup.s1.label: Grinder IP address (local network)
setup.s1.empty: Enter a valid address, for example 192.168.1.30.
setup.s1.unreached: gbs-anywhere can’t reach the grinder at {host}. Check the address and that Local WiFi is enabled.
setup.kind.title: Which grinder do you have?
setup.kind.text: The two connect to gbs-anywhere in different ways, so their steps differ.
setup.x1.title: Enable Xenia on the grinder
setup.x1.text: On the grinder, open the main menu (the lower-left button on the home screen). The grinder treats gbs-anywhere as a Xenia espresso machine.
setup.x1.network: The E64 WS uses 2.4 GHz WiFi only. Put it on the same network as the computer running gbs-anywhere.
setup.x1.question: Is Xenia enabled?
setup.x2.title: Enter gbs-anywhere’s address
setup.x2.text: Open Configuration → Edit Host. The scan won’t find gbs-anywhere, so enter its address by hand.
setup.x2.label: Address to enter on the grinder
setup.x2.byName: Enter the IP address of the computer running gbs-anywhere; your router’s device list shows it. An IP is more reliable on the grinder than a name.
setup.x2.docker: gbs-anywhere seems to run in Docker here, so it can’t see the computer’s address. Enter the IP address of the computer Docker runs on; your router’s device list shows it.
setup.x2.ip: Give that computer a fixed IP address (a DHCP reservation in your router), so the grinder keeps finding it.
setup.x2.port: This page is on port {port}, but the grinder always connects to port 80: gbs-anywhere has to answer there too.
setup.x2.question: Is the address entered on the grinder?
setup.x3.title: Wait for the grinder
setup.x3.wait: Waiting for the grinder to contact gbs-anywhere. Once connected, it does so every 2 seconds.
setup.x3.help: Nothing after a minute? Check that Xenia is still enabled, that the address is right and that the grinder is on the same network. The grinder always connects to port 80.
setup.x3.done: The grinder contacts gbs-anywhere every 2 seconds
setup.e64.title: Grinder connected
setup.e64.text:
gbs-anywhere and your E64 WS are connected.
You can grind with Grind-by-Sync now.
setup.e64.recipe: A recipe uses Grind-by-Sync when Enable GbS is on in its menu; it then shows a blue chain icon.
setup.clear.title: Clear the pairing on the grinder
setup.clear.text: On the grinder, open Configuration and tap Clear Pairing at the very bottom.
setup.clear.question: Was the pairing cleared on the grinder?
setup.clear.wait: Clear Pairing can also switch Local WiFi off on the grinder. gbs-anywhere notices the cleared pairing once Local WiFi is on again (next step); this card then shows it as done by itself.
setup.clear.subWait: Noticed once Local WiFi is on again
setup.s2.title: Start pairing on the grinder
setup.s2.sub: Enable Local WiFi, then Start Pairing
setup.s2.intro: Pairing on the grinder starts with the steps below.
setup.s21.title: Enable Local WiFi
setup.s21.menu: The lower-left button on the grinder’s home screen opens the main menu.
setup.s21.tip: Note: after the grinder restarts, this setting may be off again.
setup.s21.name: The switch’s name changes: just “Enable”, “… Generic WiFi” or “… gbs-anywhere”; “Local WiFi connected” is the line below it.
setup.s21.question: Is “Local WiFi connected” shown as enabled?
setup.s22.title: Start Pairing
setup.s22.status: While pairing runs, the grinder shows “Stop Pairing” with status “In progress” on the right side. If the status is “Timeout”, tap Start Pairing again.
setup.s22.question: Was pairing started on the grinder?
setup.note.retry: Local WiFi may have switched itself off after the restart. Enable it again first, or no pairing can start.
setup.note.cleared: Clear Pairing may have switched Local WiFi off on the grinder. Enable it again first.
setup.note.stillPaired: gbs-anywhere is still paired with the grinder, and the grinder answers. Maybe Status says “On” after all?
setup.note.mismatch: The Pairing Codes didn’t match. Don’t accept on the grinder; a new pairing attempt brings a new Pairing Code.
setup.note.notShown: “gbs-anywhere” wasn’t shown. Start pairing again on the grinder; it may have timed out.
setup.note.notAccepted: The grinder hadn’t accepted yet when gbs-anywhere checked. Tap Accept Pairing on the grinder, then Accepted here again.
setup.note.noCode: No Pairing Code yet. Check that “Local WiFi connected” is enabled, then tap Start Pairing again.
setup.s3.title: Accept device “gbs-anywhere”
setup.s31.title: Is “gbs-anywhere” shown under AVAILABLE DEVICES?
setup.s31.text: The device name is shown as: “gbs-anywhere”.
setup.s32.title: Compare the Pairing Code
setup.s32.text: Does the Pairing Code above match the grinder? Then tap “Accept Pairing” on the grinder.
setup.code.label: Pairing Code shown on the grinder
setup.code.wait: Waiting for the grinder to show “gbs-anywhere”
setup.code.note: The Pairing Code changes with every new pairing attempt.
setup.s4.title: Grinder restarts
setup.s4.unconfirmed: gbs-anywhere doesn’t reach the grinder right now. If you accepted on the grinder, it is probably restarting; otherwise it may be off or not on the WiFi.
setup.s4.hands.title: Don’t touch the grinder now.
setup.s4.hands.text: Not even Start Pairing when it shows “Timeout”, and don’t turn the knob. This page tells you when to go on.
setup.s4.flow.title: What happens now (all normal):
setup.s4.flow.titleIf: If you accepted on the grinder, this usually follows (all normal):
setup.s4.flow2: Its screen freezes and the LED pulses red
setup.s4.flow3: The LED pulses white: the grinder restarts

setup.s4.quiet.one: No answer to the pairing check: gbs-anywhere sends the grinder nothing for {n} minute, then checks again. The timer counts down to that check.
setup.s4.quiet.other: No answer to the pairing check: gbs-anywhere sends the grinder nothing for {n} minutes, then checks again. The timer counts down to that check.

setup.s4.dont3: Don’t close this page, it picks up by itself
setup.s5.title: Confirm the pairing
setup.s5.text: On the grinder, open Configuration: once paired, it shows the Pairing ID. Enter it here (1 to 65535).
setup.s5.label: Pairing ID
setup.s5.range: The Pairing ID is a number from 1 to 65535.
setup.s5.refused: The grinder did not take Pairing ID {id}. Check the Pairing ID it shows and enter it again.
setup.lost.title: The pairing wasn’t saved.
setup.lost.titleOff: The grinder no longer has the pairing request.
setup.lost.text: This happens now and then while the grinder restarts, and isn’t your fault. Every attempt makes a new Pairing Code, so go back to step 2 and please try again.
setup.lost.textOff: It may have been off, restarted or off the WiFi. If you had accepted on it, the pairing wasn’t saved. Go back to step 2 and start pairing again.
setup.lost.textGone: The pairing request ran out on the grinder, or gbs-anywhere restarted meanwhile. If you had accepted on it, the pairing wasn’t saved. Go back to step 2 and start pairing again.
setup.lost.restart: If it failed several times, a restart sometimes helps: switch the grinder off, wait 20 seconds, switch it on and wait until WiFi and cloud are connected. Then try again.
setup.done.title: Grinder paired
setup.done.text:
gbs-anywhere and your grinder are connected.
You can grind with Grind-by-Sync now.
setup.done.statusQ: On the grinder, tap the back arrow (←). Does Status under {section} say “On”?
setup.done.statusOff: The grinder doesn’t have the pairing. The setup starts again at step 2.
setup.done.home: The home icon (⌂) takes you to the main menu.
start.step1.title: Grind with the Grind-by-Sync recipe
start.step1.ready.e64: Grind with a GbS recipe, then press the grinder’s rotary knob and start the shot on the machine right away.
start.step1.ready.wifi:
Grind with a GbS recipe.
gbs-anywhere notices it by itself.
start.step1.knobRest: , then start the shot on the machine right away.
start.step2.title: Pull the shot on the espresso machine
start.step2.checkResult: Check the machine and shot result
start.step2.info.manual: No machine integration reports shots here, so enter the time and weight you measured, timed from the moment the pump starts.

start.step2.info.auto.one: {names} sends the shot’s time and weight a few seconds after it ends.
start.step2.info.auto.other: {names} send the shot’s time and weight a few seconds after it ends.

start.step2.info.limit: Without a shot within {window}, the grinder is told it was cancelled.

start.step2.missed.one: No shot from {names} yet. If it missed this one, enter it yourself.
start.step2.missed.other: No shot from {names} yet. If they missed this one, enter it yourself.

start.step2.failed.one: {names} is not working right now, so enter the shot yourself.
start.step2.failed.other: {names} are not working right now, so enter the shot yourself.

start.step2.flush: Started without a grinder request: the grinder counts it as a flush.
start.form.tooShort.e64: {limit} s or less: the grinder ignores this shot and asks you to go finer yourself.
start.form.tooShort.wifi: {limit} s or less: the grinder ignores this shot. Grind finer by hand.
start.form.tooLong: Over {limit} s: the grinder ignores this shot.
start.abort.title: Abort the shot?
start.abort.text: The grinder ignores this shot and keeps its grind setting.
start.error.stoppedWaiting: The grinder stopped waiting before the shot came
start.error.unknownApp: The grinder no longer knows this gbs-anywhere
start.error.generic: The shot did not reach the grinder
start.error.hint.before: Need more time? Raise the limit under
start.error.cancelled: The shot was cancelled. Grind again to start over at Step 1.
start.aborted.user: Aborted in the app. The grinder skips this shot.
start.aborted.address: Ended: the grinder address changed. Grind again to start over at Step 1.
start.aborted.replaced: Replaced by a newer grind. That grind is the next shot.
start.step3.title: Grinder checks and adjusts the grind
start.step3.wait: The grinder compares the shot with the recipe and adjusts.
start.step3.sum.tooShort: Too short · grind finer by hand
start.step3.sum.tooLong: Too long · ignored by the grinder
start.step3.skip: Nothing to check: no shot reached the grinder. The grind setting stays as it was.
outcome.tooShort: {time} s is too short: the grinder ignores it
outcome.tooLong: {time} s is too long: the grinder ignores it
outcome.compares: it compares the shot with the recipe
outcome.onTarget: likely on target (shot: {time} s, target: {target} s)
grinder.serverIp.docker: This looks like an address inside Docker, which the grinder can’t reach. Enter the address of the computer Docker runs on instead; your router’s list of devices shows it.
grinder.host.label: Grinder IP address
grinder.host.help: The address of an E65/E80 GbS (Local WiFi). Leave it empty when you use an E64 WS.
integ.title: Machine integrations
integ.empty: None set up: you enter each shot’s time and weight by hand on the Start tab. An integration can report them for you; tap + to add one.
integ.pick.title: What reports your shots?
integ.pick.text: Optional: it sends the time and weight to the grinder after each shot, so you don’t have to type them.
integ.notSaved: Not saved: gbs-anywhere runs without a settings file (--config), so this integration is gone after a restart.

integ.reports.one: {n} shot sent to the grinder this session
integ.reports.other: {n} shots sent to the grinder this session

integ.cmdOnly.title: {title} comes from the start settings
integ.cmdOnly.text: This integration comes from the start settings (environment variables or flags), so it can only be changed or removed there.
integ.cmdOnly.noFile: Moving it into the app needs a settings file (--config).
integ.adopt.title: Move {title} into the app?
integ.adopt.text: This integration comes from the start settings (environment variables or flags). Move it into the app to change it here? Its settings are taken over; nothing has to be typed again.
integ.adopt.textPassword: This integration comes from the start settings (environment variables or flags). Move it into the app to change it here? Its settings, including the password, are taken over; nothing has to be typed again.
integ.adopt.after: From the next start on, its flags or environment variables are ignored for as long as it is in the app. You can remove them.
integ.delete.title: Delete {title}?
integ.delete.text: This stops the integration and removes its saved settings. Shots are then no longer reported by themselves.
integ.delete.textPassword: This stops the integration and removes its saved settings, including the password. Shots are then no longer reported by themselves.
integ.delete.moved: It was moved into the app from the start settings. If its flags or environment variables are still set, they start it again at the next start; remove them to turn it off for good.
integ.edit.label: Edit {title}
integ.passwordSaved: Saved. Leave this empty to keep the saved password.
settings.title: Settings
settings.windowSub: after the grind, before a timeout
settings.windowInvalid: Type a time from {min} to {max} min: a whole number is minutes up to 60 and seconds above (3 or 150), one with decimals is minutes ({decimal}); or write 2:30 or 150 s. 0 is no limit.
settings.from.app: Set in the app · start setting: {value}
settings.saved: The settings for time to pull the shot and the update check, and the grinder IP address on the grinder card, are saved on the computer (gbs-anywhere host) and kept after a restart. “Use start setting” goes back to the value of the environment variable or flag, else the default. Appearance and language apply to this device only.
settings.notPersistent: The settings for time to pull the shot and the update check, and the grinder IP address on the grinder card, apply until the next restart: gbs-anywhere runs without a settings file (--config). “Use start setting” goes back to the value of the environment variable or flag, else the default. Appearance and language apply to this device only.
version.whatsNewLabel: What’s new (opens in a new tab)
version.note: Checks GitHub once a day for a newer release.
version.github: gbs-anywhere on GitHub (opens in a new tab)

history.empty: No shots yet. Each shot shows up here once it is done.

history.kept.one: The last shot is kept on this computer.
history.kept.other: The last {n} shots are kept on this computer.
